PROPERTY MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT

This Property Management Agreement (this "Agreement") is made as of March 2, 2026 between Halverson Ridge Apartments LLC, an Arizona limited liability company ("Owner"), and Sonoran Crest Management, Inc., an Arizona corporation holding Arizona real estate broker license number BR-558214 ("Manager").

1. APPOINTMENT AND PROPERTY

1.1 Appointment. Owner appoints Manager as the exclusive managing agent of the property known as Halverson Ridge Apartments, 4820 East Camelback Loop, Phoenix, Maricopa County, Arizona, consisting of 188 residential units (the "Property"), and Manager accepts the appointment.

1.2 Standard of Care. Manager shall manage the Property in a commercially reasonable manner, in accordance with the annual budget Owner approves, and in compliance with all applicable law, including the Fair Housing Act, the Arizona Residential Landlord and Tenant Act, and the licensing requirements of the Arizona Department of Real Estate.

2. TERM

2.1 Term. The term begins on April 1, 2026 and continues for two (2) years, renewing automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term.

3. AUTHORITY AND DUTIES

3.1 Leasing. Manager shall market the Property, screen applicants in accordance with written criteria Owner approves, execute leases on Owner's approved form for terms of six (6) to fifteen (15) months, and enforce the leases, including serving notices and, with Owner's prior approval, commencing eviction proceedings in Owner's name.

3.2 Collections. Manager shall collect all rents, deposits, and other charges, and shall deposit them in the Operating Account described in Section 4.

3.3 Maintenance and Repairs. Manager shall arrange routine maintenance and repairs. Manager shall obtain Owner's prior written approval for any single expenditure over $3,500, except that Manager may make an emergency expenditure without prior approval where necessary to protect the Property or the safety of residents, and shall notify Owner within twenty-four (24) hours.

3.4 Personnel. All on-site personnel are employees of Manager, not of Owner. Manager is solely responsible for their wages, benefits, payroll taxes, workers' compensation, and compliance with wage-and-hour law, and shall be reimbursed for those costs from the Operating Account in accordance with the approved budget.

3.5 Contracts. Manager may enter into service contracts terminable on thirty (30) days' notice without penalty. Any longer-term contract requires Owner's prior written approval.

3.6 Budget and Reporting. Manager shall submit a proposed annual operating and capital budget at least sixty (60) days before each fiscal year. Manager shall deliver monthly financial statements, a rent roll, a delinquency report, and a variance analysis by the fifteenth (15th) day of the following month, and shall deliver supporting documentation on request.

4. FUNDS AND TRUST ACCOUNTS

4.1 Operating Account. Manager shall establish and maintain a separate federally insured account in Owner's name (the "Operating Account") for the receipts and disbursements of the Property. Manager shall not commingle Owner's funds with Manager's own funds or with the funds of any other owner.

4.2 Security Deposits. Manager shall hold all resident security deposits in a separate trust account as A.R.S. § 33-1321 requires, and shall account for them separately from operating funds.

4.3 Disbursements. Manager shall pay operating expenses, debt service, and other obligations from the Operating Account in accordance with the approved budget, and shall remit the net cash flow to Owner by the twentieth (20th) day of each month, retaining a working-capital reserve of $75,000.

4.4 Records and Audit. Manager shall keep complete books and records of the Property at its principal office, in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, and shall make them available for Owner's inspection and audit on five (5) business days' notice. Manager shall retain the records for five (5) years after the end of the term.

5. COMPENSATION

5.1 Management Fee. Owner shall pay Manager a management fee of four percent (4%) of Gross Collections each month, payable from the Operating Account on the tenth (10th) day of the following month.

5.2 Leasing Fee. Owner shall pay Manager a leasing fee of $350 for each new lease executed and $150 for each renewal.

5.3 Construction Supervision. For any capital project exceeding $50,000 that Owner approves, Owner shall pay Manager a construction supervision fee of five percent (5%) of the hard cost of the project.

5.4 No Other Compensation. Manager shall not accept any rebate, discount, or other compensation from any vendor or contractor serving the Property, and shall credit any such amount received to the Operating Account. All fees payable to Manager are set out in this Section 5.

6. INSURANCE AND INDEMNITY

6.1 Owner's Insurance. Owner shall maintain property and commercial general liability insurance covering the Property, naming Manager as an additional insured, and shall deliver certificates to Manager annually.

6.2 Manager's Insurance. Manager shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of $1,000,000 per occurrence, workers' compensation as required by law, a fidelity bond of at least $250,000 covering Manager's employees handling Owner's funds, and errors and omissions coverage of $1,000,000.

6.3 Indemnity by Owner. Owner shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Manager against any claim arising out of the ownership or operation of the Property, other than a claim arising from Manager's gross negligence, willful misconduct, or breach of this Agreement.

6.4 Indemnity by Manager. Manager shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Owner against any claim arising from Manager's gross negligence, willful misconduct, breach of this Agreement, or violation of law by Manager or its employees.

7. TERMINATION

7.1 Termination for Convenience. Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause on sixty (60) days' written notice.

7.2 Termination for Cause. Either party may terminate immediately on written notice if the other materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure within fifteen (15) days, and Owner may terminate immediately if Manager loses its real estate broker license, misappropriates funds, or files for bankruptcy.

7.3 Effect of Termination. On termination, Manager shall deliver to Owner, within fifteen (15) days, all funds held for Owner's account, all books and records, all leases and resident files, all keys and access credentials, and all security deposits, and shall render a final accounting within thirty (30) days. Manager is entitled to fees earned through the termination date. Sections 4.4, 6 and 8 survive.

8. GENERAL

8.1 Governing Law; Venue. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Arizona. Any action arising out of this Agreement shall be brought in the state or federal courts located in Maricopa County, Arizona.

8.2 Assignment. Manager may not assign this Agreement or delegate its duties without Owner's prior written consent. Owner may assign this Agreement to a transferee of the Property.

8.3 Independent Contractor. Manager is an independent contractor and not a partner or joint venturer of Owner.

8.4 Notices. All notices shall be in writing and delivered by hand, by nationally recognized overnight courier, or by certified mail, return receipt requested, to the addresses stated beneath the signatures.

8.5 Entire Agreement; Amendment. This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties and may be amended only in a writing signed by both.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.
